name: Tokuzawa Akemi
source:
Older sister to Hina.

A beautiful young wife with a mature and voluptuous body and a healing nature. She is a housewife.

She lives in the same apartment building with the protagonist and often comes face-to-face with him. She is ladylike with a reserve personality.

She is not accustomed to the world and is easily defenseless. She loves her husband, who tends to go on long business trips, and they make love fiercely whenever they can.
Akemi is a symbol of sexuality that is familiar to the protagonist and his first partner.

The person who helped kick-start the groundwork for the protagonist plan to blackmail and rape.

[Translated from [url=https://www.digiket.com/work/show/_data/ID=ITM0119113/]Digiket[/url]]
